name: x-marketplace-seller-mcp
description: Sell items on X: create listings with a private floor and ceiling, draft buyer replies with intent and scam detection, run a negotiation engine that never goes below your floor or reveals it, draft pickup/delivery handoffs, and keep a deal ledger. Posting and DMs use your own X token, and every post, DM or deal needs explicit confirmation. Storage is isolated per user.

X_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: X user access token
X_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Your own X OAuth 2.0 user-context token with tweet.write (and dm.write for DMs). Only needed to post listings or send DMs.
